items.title: Has Oracle Become A Weaker Business, Or Just A Cheaper Stock?
items.summary: Oracle (ORCL) made almost a quarter more operating profit in its last fiscal year. Yet when trading closed on September 10, the stock sat around 53% under the peak it reached a year before. Rising profit and a falling price point to one of two stories: trouble the results have not caught up with, or a sound company that has been repriced. The question is whether Oracle is turning into a weaker business, or has just become a cheaper stock.

items.title: Adobe Just Fell Off Another Cliff: Why One Wall Street Manager Remains Resolute That It Will Increase 55% Soon
items.summary: Adobe keeps beating earnings and raising guidance, yet its stock has collapsed nearly 29% this year while one analyst holds a price target that implies a 55% surge. Something in the market's reaction does not add up, and the answer reveals a high-stakes bet on whether Adobe's AI strategy is a trap or a springboard.
